As we all know, we currently have no stock of it on-site. I know we have our weekly emergency-readiness huddle where clinical, pharmacy, and finance will report their implementation requirements, but I wanted to open the floor now so we can start thinking through this together. I should mention that I do have a designated locked cabinet available in the medication room that could be used for a new emergency medication like this. I'll be making the final decision on whether and how the antidote gets stocked, but I want to hear from all of you before we finalize anything. What are your initial thoughts?
